verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly markets running operations "from your terminal, a script, or a CI pipeline" and ships an official terminal-native CLI that authenticates non-interactively via a MERCURY_API_KEY environment variable. That headless path is backed by scoped read-only, read-write and custom API tokens, a full REST API, an official Go SDK, and a separate sandbox environment with its own base URLs for safe automated testing. missing for 10: dedicated CI-integration docs or examples (e.g. pipeline recipes, exit-code/output-format docs for the CLI), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI/CI use.
